lines.en: label day110:
There are several things in life I have accepted that I will never understand.
lines.zh: 这世上有几件事，我已经接受了自己永远不会明白。

lines.en: The first, the last, and the most damning of all of them is the fact that we have two lives- not just one.
lines.zh: 其中第一件、最后一件，也是最要命的一件，就是我们拥有两段人生——而不是一段。

lines.en: The first life is what comes prior to adulthood- and how that extremely brief period of time is somehow more important than everything that comes after it.
lines.zh: 第一段人生是成年之前的日子——而这段极其短暂的时光，不知怎么地就比之后的一切都更重要。

lines.en: So, why is it that smaller of two lives is the one that, for the most part, determines how the second life plays out?
lines.zh: 那么，为什么两段人生里较短的那一段，却在很大程度上决定了第二段人生会怎么展开？

lines.en: Why do we allow ourselves to be manipulated by the people and things that surround us so frequently in the beginning, yet never at all after finally experiencing it?
lines.zh: 为什么我们一开始那么轻易地被周围的人与事所摆布，可在真正经历过之后，却再也不会了？

lines.en: The first life is the one we idealize- where that manipulation is something we wrap around ourselves like a scarf to protect us from the cold which, in this case, is all that we're unfamiliar with.
lines.zh: 第一段人生是我们理想化的那一段——在那里，这种摆布被我们像围巾一样裹在身上，用来抵御寒冷，而这里的寒冷，指的就是我们所有不熟悉的东西。

lines.en: But it isn't until the second life where we discover that we {i}like{/i} the cold and discard the scarf entirely, only to regret the decision thereafter because the feel of the fabric was comforting.
lines.zh: 可直到第二段人生，我们才发现自己{i}喜欢{/i}寒冷，于是把围巾彻底扔掉，之后却又后悔这个决定，因为布料的触感曾让人安心。

lines.en: By the second life, we have become so resistant to manipulation that we no longer allow others to change us and, instead, are forced into a state of being where we must manipulate ourselves.
lines.zh: 到了第二段人生，我们已经变得如此抗拒被摆布，以至于不再允许别人改变我们，反而被迫进入一种必须自我摆布的状态。

lines.en: For if we didn't, we'd be stuck perpetually remembering our first lives.
lines.zh: 因为如果不这样，我们就会永远困在对第一段人生的回忆里。

lines.en: We'd be stuck wishing to trade away the longer portion for another set of firsts and the opportunity to soften our skin.
lines.zh: 我们会一直盼望着用更长的那一段，去换另一组「第一次」，换一个磨软自己皮肤的机会。

lines.en: Resistance is only a strength when we want it to be.
lines.zh: 抗拒只有在我们希望它是的时候，才算是一种力量。

lines.en: The rest of the time, it is a reminder that half of our humanity faded away the second we grew up.
lines.zh: 其余的时候，它只是在提醒我们，人性的一半在我们长大的那一刻就已经消失了。

lines.en: So...what is left to do now?
lines.zh: 那么……现在还剩下什么可做呢？

lines.en: What is left to do knowing that we can't go back and that we must fall into place and only look back on the happier days as a means of coping?
lines.zh: 既然知道回不去了，既然知道我们必须各就各位，只能把回望那些更快乐的日子当作一种自我安慰，那还剩下什么可做呢？

lines.en: The answer to that is simple, for it's the same for everyone.
lines.zh: 答案很简单，因为对每个人来说都一样。

lines.en: You find a job.
lines.zh: 你找一份工作。

lines.en: You find a partner (Preferably one who swallows.)
lines.zh: 你找一个伴侣（最好是会吞的。）

lines.en: You start a family.
lines.zh: 你组建一个家庭。

lines.en: You die.
lines.zh: 你死去。

lines.en: The worst part of all of that, though, is that you wind up having to train yourself for that final step for the entirety of your second life.
lines.zh: 不过，这一切里最糟糕的是，你得用整个第二段人生，来训练自己走完最后那一步。

lines.en: There are no {i}firsts{/i} left at this point anymore-
lines.zh: 到了这一步，已经不再有任何{i}「第一次」{/i}了——

lines.en: Just a series of events that you’re forced to assign meaning to so you won’t be as terrified when you're dying alone in a hospital bed somewhere.
lines.zh: 只剩下一连串你被迫赋予意义的事件，好让你将来孤零零地死在某张病床上时，不至于那么害怕。

lines.en: Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美吧。

lines.en: Praise the {s}God{/s} god who wanted us to live these tragic, hopeless lives.
lines.zh: 赞美那位希望我们过这种悲惨而无望的人生的 {s}God{/s} 神。

lines.en: A song plays in the back of my head.
lines.zh: 一首歌在我脑海深处响起。

lines.en: It’s a song that reminds me of cursed birds and familiar sins.
lines.zh: 那是一首让我想起被诅咒的鸟和熟悉的罪的歌。

lines.en: But it’s a song filled with hope.
lines.zh: 但那是一首充满希望的歌。

lines.en: A song of death and a song of life.
lines.zh: 一首死亡之歌，也是一首生命之歌。

lines.en: One song for everyone.
lines.zh: 一首给所有人的歌。

lines.en: A final melody as the darkness closes in.
lines.zh: 黑暗合拢时的最后一段旋律。

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
: [amimaster], are you awake in there?
lines.zh: : [amimaster]，你醒着吗？

lines.en: : Huh?
: Oh, uhh...
: Yeah.
: Sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: scene black
scene living1
: Morning!
lines.zh: : 早上好！

lines.en: : Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Hey...good morning. I didn’t sleep late, did I?
lines.zh: : 嘿……早上好。我没睡过头吧？

lines.en: : Not really, but I felt like you probably would have if I didn't come wake you up.
lines.zh: : 倒也没有，不过我觉得要是我不来叫你，你大概就睡过头了。

lines.en: : You feeling okay? You look a little out of it.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？看起来有点魂不守舍。

lines.en: : I can make you coffee if-
lines.zh: : 我给你煮杯咖啡吧，要是——

lines.en: : I'm fine. Just...feeling a little zoned out, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我没事。只是……有点走神吧，大概。

lines.en: scene living2
: Zoned out? You’re not getting sick, are you?
lines.zh: : 走神？你该不会是生病了吧？

lines.en: : Should we maybe stay home today?
lines.zh: : 要不我们今天干脆待在家里？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s anything that serious. Probably just a...lack of sleep or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那么严重。大概只是……睡眠不足什么的。

lines.en: scene living3
: Huh. Didn't you say the same thing this morning, Maya?
lines.zh: : 嗯。Maya，你今早是不是也说了同样的话？

lines.en: : That sounds possible. But, then again, I believe that any amount of sleep less than twelve hours is a lack and I seldom actually get that much.
lines.zh: : 有这个可能。不过话说回来，我认为任何少于十二小时的睡眠都属于不足，而我很少真能睡够那么久。

lines.en: : That sounds like a medical issue or something. You should get that checked out.
lines.zh: : 听起来像是某种病啊。你该去看看。

lines.en: : Complaining about being tired in the morning is normal human nature. And I refuse to get help for simply being human.
lines.zh: : 早上抱怨困是正常的人类天性。我拒绝仅仅因为自己是人就去求助。

lines.en: scene living4
: Just say you're fine next time...jeez.
lines.zh: : 那你下次直接说「我没事」就行了……天哪。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, what is Maya doing here so early anyway? She doesn’t normally meet us at the house.
lines.zh: : 说起来，Maya 今天怎么这么早就在这儿？她平时不在家里等我们的。

lines.en: scene living5
: Have you given up on asking me things directly? You need to go through Ami now?
lines.zh: : 你已经放弃直接问我了吗？现在要经过 Ami 才行？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever had a positive experience when it comes to communicating with you before lunch time, so yes. I am going to go through Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不记得午餐之前跟你交流有过什么愉快的经历，所以，对。我就是要通过 Ami。

lines.en: : That’s understandable. But to add to that, I haven’t ever had a good experience talking to you in general.
lines.zh: : 可以理解。但补充一点，总的来说，我跟你说话也从没有过愉快的经历。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. There's had to be at least {i}one.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。总该有{i}一次{/i}吧。

lines.en: : Not that I can think of.
lines.zh: : 我想不出来。

lines.en: scene living6
Ami’s eyes bounce back and forth between Maya and me.
lines.zh: Ami 的目光在我和 Maya 之间来回游移。

lines.en: I can’t blame her for not knowing how to deal with the dynamic between the two of us, especially this early in the morning.
lines.zh: 我不能怪她不知道该怎么应付我们俩之间的这种关系，尤其是在这么早的早上。

lines.en: Hell, I don’t even understand the dynamic between us right now and we kind of...saw the end of the world together?
lines.zh: 见鬼，连我自己现在都搞不懂我们之间是什么关系，而我们好歹算是……一起见证了世界末日？

lines.en: Still not quite sure what happened there, but I’m glad it’s over.
lines.zh: 我到现在也不太清楚当时发生了什么，不过我很高兴那件事已经过去了。

lines.en: scene living5
: Did something happen between you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩之间发生什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene living7
: Hm? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？

lines.en: : You guys just seem...a little different somehow. Like, I can still feel the hate, but now it’s more like a comfortable hate rather than an...{i}uncomfortable{/i} hate.
lines.zh: : 你们看起来就是……有点不一样了。怎么说呢，我还能感觉到那股恨意，但现在更像是一种舒服的恨，而不是……{i}让人难受的{/i}恨。

lines.en: : Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 你懂我的意思吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不懂。

lines.en: : I have literally no idea what that is supposed to mean.
lines.zh: : 我真的一点都不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Maya reset the world for me.
lines.zh: : Maya 为我重置了世界。

lines.en: scene living8
scene living9
: What the heck is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思啊？

lines.en: Yeah, that’s pretty much the reaction I was expecting.
lines.zh: 是啊，这基本就是我预料中的反应。

lines.en: It was pretty easy to tell that Ami had no idea what happened the second everything restarted.
lines.zh: 一切重启的那一刻，就很容易看出来 Ami 完全不知道发生了什么。

lines.en: Granted, it took me around half an hour to realize it as well...and I knew it was coming.
lines.zh: 话说回来，我自己也花了差不多半小时才反应过来……而我可是早就知道它会来的。

lines.en: : How does somebody reset the world, exactly?
lines.zh: : 一个人到底是怎么重置世界的？

lines.en: : No clue. Ask her, she knows.
lines.zh: : 不知道。问她，她知道。

lines.en: scene living10
: Hey, wait a sec! You two didn’t start playing some new online game without me, did you?!
lines.zh: : 喂，等等！你们俩该不会是背着我偷偷玩什么新的网络游戏了吧？！

lines.en: : Do you really think I have time for games?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我有时间玩游戏？

lines.en: : Yes! You never do anything!
lines.zh: : 有！你什么都不干！

lines.en: : Okay, better question- do you really think I would use all of my free time on games and not...other stuff?
lines.zh: : 好吧，换个问法——你真觉得我会把全部空闲时间花在游戏上，而不是……别的事？

lines.en: : I don't know! Maybe!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！也许吧！

lines.en: scene living11
: There’s obviously no game, Ami. You should know by now to take everything this person says with a grain of salt.
lines.zh: : 显然没有什么游戏，Ami。你到现在也该知道，这个人说的一切都得打个折扣听。

lines.en: : Person? Really? Have I been downgraded and stripped of my gender overnight?
lines.zh: : 「这个人」？真的假的？我一夜之间就被降级、被剥夺性别了吗？

lines.en: : Besides, if I were to start playing a new game, you would be the first to know.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我要开始玩新游戏，你会是第一个知道的。

lines.en: : And now you’re ignoring me. See, this is exactly why I don't talk to you before lunch.
lines.zh: : 现在你又无视我了。看，这就是为什么我午餐前不跟你说话。

lines.en: : I guess that makes sense...Ayane is no fun to play with since she always has all the best stuff.
lines.zh: : 我想也是……话说 Ayane 玩起来一点都不好玩，因为她永远有最好的东西。

lines.en: : Is Ayane really that good at video games?
lines.zh: : Ayane 真的那么擅长打游戏吗？

lines.en: I try desperately to insert myself back into the conversation and force both Maya and Ami to remember that I am here.
lines.zh: 我拼命想把自己塞回对话里，逼 Maya 和 Ami 想起我还在这儿。

lines.en: scene living12
: Not really. She just has unrestricted credit card access and uses her dad's money to roll on every banner and make the two of us feel insignificant.
lines.zh: : 不算。她只是有不受限制的信用卡，拿她爸的钱在每个卡池里狂抽，让我们两个觉得自己渺小无比。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes...banners. I understand exactly what you mean by that.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊……卡池。我完全懂你的意思。

lines.en: scene living13
: All {i}you{/i} have to understand is that you could easily fix this problem by giving me-
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}只需要明白，这个问题你很容易就能解决，只要给我——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : By giving me access to-
lines.zh: : 只要给我开通——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : By-
lines.zh: : 只要——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene living14
: Anyway, I’m not really sure what's going on with you two, but I’m definitely gonna be keeping my eye out from now on...or at least until you clear yourselves of suspicion.
lines.zh: : 总之，我不太确定你们俩在搞什么，但我从现在起一定会盯紧的……至少在你们洗清嫌疑之前。

lines.en: : I’ll be damned if anyone steals my [uncle] away, especially my best friend.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会让任何人偷走我的[uncle]，尤其是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: scene living15
: Uhh...Yeah, I wouldn’t really worry about that if I were you.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，换作是我，我倒真不会担心这个。

lines.en: : Getting close to your [uncle] is at the very bottom of my list of ‘things I want to do’ right alongside being crucified and/or submerged in acid.
lines.zh: : 跟你[uncle]搞好关系，在我「想做的事」清单上排在最末尾，和「被钉十字架」以及／或者「被泡在酸里」并列。

lines.en: : Okay, I think it’s a little unfair to compare me to things like that.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我觉得拿我和那种东西相比有点不公平。

lines.en: scene living16
: You're right. That would be too rude to acid.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那对酸也太失礼了。

lines.en: You know...just when I thought Maya and I were about to get closer, she starts saying things like that.
lines.zh: 你知道吗……就在我以为我和 Maya 快要拉近关系的时候，她就开始说这种话。

lines.en: : Okay...so maybe there isn’t anything going on with you two after all.
lines.zh: : 好吧……那也许你们俩之间真的没什么。

lines.en: : I’m just gonna chalk all of this up to lack of sleep on both sides. Sound good?
lines.zh: : 我就当这一切都是因为你们俩都缺觉吧。行吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Wonderful.
lines.zh: : 好。妙极了。

lines.en: : I don’t even care anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经不在乎了。

lines.en: scene living1
: Great! Thankfully, I got enough sleep to make up for both of you, so you can just let me do all the talking on the way to...
lines.zh: : 太好了！幸好我睡得够多，能补上你们俩的份，所以去……的路上就让我来说话吧。

lines.en: : ...school.
Right. We’re supposed to be going to[school].
lines.zh: 对。我们本来是要去[school]的。

lines.en: Whoops.
lines.zh: 糟糕。

lines.en: scene living17
: Sensei...what should we do? I don't want Makoto to kill us for being late.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我们该怎么办？我可不想被 Makoto 因为迟到给杀了。

lines.en: : Don't worry. I think the three of us can take her if we coordinate well enough.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我觉得只要我们配合得好，三个人一起上还是能打得过她的。

lines.en: : Is it too late to call out? Can we just...do that and stay here?
lines.zh: : 现在请假还来得及吗？我们能不能就……那样，然后待在这儿？

lines.en: : I’m fine with being late.
lines.zh: : 我迟到无所谓。

lines.en: : Sensei is the one who handles the attendance sheets, so...
lines.zh: : 考勤表是 Sensei 管的，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah, I think we’ll be fine. We can just come up with an excuse or something if Makoto asks us.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得不会有事的。要是 Makoto 问起来，我们随便编个理由就行了。

lines.en: : Well...what kind of excuse? Because it would have to be a believable one for Makoto to fall for it.
lines.zh: : 那……什么理由？毕竟得是可信的理由，Makoto 才会上当。

lines.en: : I don't know. Maybe that the house caught on fire because you messed up cooking or something?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。要不就说你做饭失误把房子点着了之类的？

lines.en: scene living18
: That's not believable at all! That’s just mean! I'd never do something like that!
lines.zh: : 这根本不可信！这也太过分了！我绝不会做那种事！

lines.en: : You lit the science room on fire a while ago, didn't you? I think a house fire would be pretty easy to believe.
lines.zh: : 你不是之前把科学教室给点了吗？我觉得房子着火这说法挺容易让人信的。

lines.en: : Why do you remember that?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么会记得那件事啊？！

lines.en: : That was a very bad day for me.
lines.zh: : 那天对我来说是非常糟糕的一天。

lines.en: : Have I ever mentioned how intimidating Yumi is?
lines.zh: : 我说过 Yumi 有多吓人吗？

lines.en: scene living19
: At least you didn’t almost kill the entire class, Maya! Imagine how I feel!
lines.zh: : 至少你没有差点把全班都害死啊，Maya！想想我的感受吧！

lines.en: : Okay, are we going to just stand here in the living room for the rest of the day, or are we actually going to go to[school]?
lines.zh: : 好了，我们是打算在客厅里站一整天，还是真的要去[school]？

lines.en: scene living20
: Ugh...fine. I accept my fate.
lines.zh: : 唉……好吧。我认命了。

lines.en: : But know now that I would never light this house on fire because I care too much about it.
lines.zh: : 但你要知道，我绝不会把这座房子点着，因为我太在乎它了。

lines.en: : Please apply that same level of care to school so that we may continue living. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请把同等程度的在乎也用在学校上，好让我们能继续活下去。谢谢。

lines.en: : Are you ready to go as well, Maya? Or are you just...going to stay here?
lines.zh: : 你也准备走了吗，Maya？还是说你就……待在这儿？

lines.en: scene living21
: Please don’t say my name. It sounds disgusting when you do it.
lines.zh: : 请别叫我的名字。你叫起来让人恶心。

lines.en: : Then...what am I supposed to call you?
lines.zh: : 那……我该怎么称呼你？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么都别叫。

lines.en: : Are you coming to school or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底去不去学校？

lines.en: : Do I actually have a choice? Or is that a rhetorical question?
lines.zh: : 我真有得选吗？还是说这是个反问？

lines.en: : Because I very much would prefer to stay here in the air conditioning.
lines.zh: : 因为我更想待在这里吹空调。

lines.en: : Just come to school, Maya...we can hang out in the air conditioning later.
lines.zh: : 来学校吧，Maya……空调我们可以晚点再吹。

lines.en: scene black
scene living22
: {i}Hah...{/i}This is it...The day I’m finally killed by the student council president.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}就是今天了……我终于要被学生会长杀掉的日子。

lines.en: : It has been a pleasure knowing you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 认识你很荣幸，Ami。

lines.en: : I always knew something like this would be the end of me...I just didn’t realize it would be so soon.
lines.zh: : 我一直知道会有什么东西要了我的命……只是没想到会来得这么快。

lines.en: : What a strangely specific prediction for your demise.
lines.zh: : 对自己死法的预测还真是具体得离谱。

lines.en: : Fare thee well, beloved [uncle]. Do not forget me if you live to see tomorrow...
lines.zh: : 永别了，亲爱的[uncle]。要是你能活到明天，别忘了我……

lines.en: scene black
Ami disappears into the classroom, leaving Maya and me alone in the hall.
lines.zh: Ami 消失在教室里，走廊上只剩 Maya 和我两个人。

lines.en: : Well then, I guess I’ll-
lines.zh: : 那么，我想我该——

lines.en: : Hold up one second, Maya.
lines.zh: : 等一下，Maya。

lines.en: scene living23
: Funny. I believe I told you to stop calling me that.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我记得我告诉过你别那么叫我。

lines.en: : You did, but this is important.
lines.zh: : 你是说过，但这件事很重要。

lines.en: : Are we just going to ignore everything that happened the other day?
lines.zh: : 我们就要当那天的事没发生过吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : The thing on the roof? The end of the world?
lines.zh: : 天台上的事？世界末日？

lines.en: scene living24
Maya pauses for a long time and scans the hallway to make sure that no one is around- not that I think anyone would believe her even if they were.
lines.zh: Maya 停顿了很久，扫视了一遍走廊，确认周围没有人——虽然我觉得就算有人在，也不会有人相信她。

lines.en: : Yes.
: We {i}are{/i} going to ignore that.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}就要{/i}当它没发生过。

lines.en: : Please continue on with your daily life as if nothing has changed.
lines.zh: : 请继续过你的日常生活，就当什么都没变过。

lines.en: : Though, I would appreciate it if you’d make it to the roof much quicker in the future.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果以后你能更快点到天台，我会很感激的。

lines.en: : It took you quite a while the last time.
lines.zh: : 上次你花了不少时间。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose it doesn’t matter at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 虽然，我想说到底也无所谓。

lines.en: : It's not as if I'm expecting to ever see you there again or anything.
lines.zh: : 我又没指望还能在那里再见到你什么的。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Okay then?...
lines.zh: : 那好吧？……

lines.en: scene living23
: If that's all, I’m going to go sit at my desk now.
lines.zh: : 要是没别的事，我现在要去坐回我的座位了。

lines.en: : The bell for second period is about to ring and I, too, do not want to be killed today.
lines.zh: : 第二节课的铃快响了，我今天也不想被杀。

lines.en: scene black
Maybe...Maya just doesn’t want to talk about it during[school] hours?
lines.zh: 也许……Maya 只是不想在[school]时间里谈这件事？

lines.en: It’s not like that topic is something the two of us can avoid forever, though, is it?
lines.zh: 不过这个话题，我们两个也不可能永远躲着不谈，对吧？

lines.en: I have so many questions...things I couldn’t think of when the two of us met under the stars.
lines.zh: 我有太多问题了……那些我们俩在星空下见面时我没能想到的问题。

lines.en: But, perhaps, the biggest question of all-
lines.zh: 但，也许，最大的那个问题——

lines.en: Is if Makoto is going to let me live through the day to find all of those answers.
lines.zh: 是 Makoto 今天会不会让我活着走出这里，去找到所有那些答案。
